description: Create item models («Modelle») in one call: one model per article type whose pieces share a name and settings, e.g. «Arbeitshose» in sizes XS to 8XL, or 16 identical radios. Same contract as scaffold_categories: without confirm: true it is a dry run that writes nothing; the SAME call with confirm: true commits. Per model: name, categoryId, and how its pieces are named: nameSuffix "none" (every piece carries the model's name), "text" (each piece keeps its own suffix from its row: «Funkgerät 3») or "field" with nameSuffixFieldId (a select, text or number field: «Arbeitshose XL»); variantValues, the values a field may take on this model (the sizes it exists in); defaultFieldValues, the values every new piece gets. An existing model of the same name is reused, never duplicated; one whose settings differ (category, name suffix, allowed values, or a named default) is reported as a conflict and left as it is. Models are created last to first, so the app's model list opens on the first one. plan_import adds the pieces: the model's name in a blueprintName column and the size in its field's column. Model pictures are added in the app. At most 50 models per call. Requires the manager role. Idempotent: a repeated commit reuses every model.

confirm.description: true commits the plan; absent or false = dry run, nothing written

models.description: The models, at most 50 per call

defaultFieldValues.description: Values every new piece of this model gets

value.description: The value as text: a date as "YYYY-MM-DD" (a calendar day, no time zone to convert), a number as "12.5", a select value as one of its options, a multi-select value as several of its options separated by ";" ("HDMI; VGA" — not commas: an option name may itself contain a comma)

nameSuffix.description: How its pieces are named: "none" = the model name, "text" = each piece its own suffix, "field" = the value of nameSuffixFieldId. Default "none" ("field" when nameSuffixFieldId is set)

nameSuffixFieldId.description: A field id (from get_item_requirements) or "field:<label>" — a select, text or number field of the category whose value ends each piece's name

variantValues.description: Allowed values per field — the sizes or variants

values.description: The values this field may take on the model (select: its options)

name: scaffold_models

instruction.description: Preview mode: what the same call with confirm: true would do

models.description: One row per model, in the order of the request

action.description: "create", "existing" (same name, reused), "conflict" (same name, other settings — left unchanged) or "invalid" (skipped)

code.description: Why an invalid row is invalid (the app's code)

detail.description: How to fix an invalid row

differences.description: What differs on a conflict row

field.description: The field the code is about

modelId.description: The model's id — created (commit) or existing

webUrl.description: The model's page in the web app, for a person to open; the id is the handle for tool calls

preview.description: True = dry run, NOTHING was written; the same call with confirm: true commits it

warnings.description: Rows skipped on commit — commit mode
